    patch2.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(1.0, 0.5, 0.5))
    patch2.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/concrete.jpg"), 20, 20)

    patch3_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
    patch3_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
    patch3_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
    patch3 = terrain.AddPatch(patch3_mat, chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, -42, 0), chrono.QUNIT),
                              veh.GetDataFile("terrain/meshes/bump.obj"))

    vis.SetWindowTitle('HMMWV Rigid Terrain Demo')
    vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
    vis.SetChaseCamera(chrono.ChVector3d(0.0, 0.0, 0.75), 6.0, 0.5)
    vis.Initialize()
    vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
    vis.AddLightDirectional()
    vis.AddSkyBox()
    vis.AttachVehicle(hmmwv.GetVehicle())

    driver.SetSteeringDelta(0.02)
    driver.SetThrottleDelta(0.02)
    driver.SetBrakingDelta(0.06)
    driver.Initialize()

    hmmwv.GetVehicle().EnableRealtime(True)

    while vis.Run() :
        time = hmmwv.GetSystem().GetChTime()

        # Draw scene
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()

        # Get driver inputs
        driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

        # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
        driver.Synchronize(time)
        terrain.Synchronize(time)
        hmmwv.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
        vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

        # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
        driver.Advance(step_size)
        terrain.Advance(step_size)
        hmmwv.Advance(step_size)
        vis.Advance(step_size)

    return 0

veh.SetDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + 'vehicle/')

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 2e-3
tire_step_size = 1e-3


main()

import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr

# Initialize PyChrono
chrono.ChSystem.ChronoSystem.SetDefaultContactModel(chrono.ChContactModelNSC)
chrono.ChSystem.ChronoSystem.SetDefaultContactMaterial(chrono.ChMaterialNSC)

# Create the simulation system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# Set the gravitational acceleration
system.g = chrono.ChVector3D(0, -9.81, 0)

# Create the Irrlicht application
irr_app = irr.ChIrrApp(system, "HMMWV Simulation", chrono.ChVector3D(800, 600))
irr_app.SetTimestep(0.01)
irr_app.SetRenderMode(irr.ChIrrApp.RenderMode.Solid)

# Create the HMMWV vehicle
vehicle = veh.ChHMMWV()

# Set vehicle parameters
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionShape(chrono.ChCollisionShapeBox(1, 1, 1))
vehicle.SetEngine(veh.ChEngineSimple())
vehicle.SetTransmission(veh.ChTransmissionSimple())

# Add vehicle components
system.Add(vehicle.GetChassisBody())
system.Add(vehicle.GetEngine())
system.Add(vehicle.GetTransmission())

# Create terrain
terrain = chrono.ChTerrain()

# Add flat terrain patches with different textures
flat_terrain1 = chrono.ChBody()
flat_terrain1.SetCollisionShape(chrono.ChCollisionShapeBox(10, 1, 10))
flat_terrain1.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3D(0, -5, 0))
system.Add(flat_terrain1)

flat_terrain2 = chrono.ChBody()
flat_terrain2.SetCollisionShape(chrono.ChCollisionShapeBox(10, 1, 10))
flat_terrain2.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3D(10, -5, 0))
system.Add(flat_terrain2)

# Add mesh-based terrain patch
mesh_terrain = chrono.ChBody()
mesh_terrain.SetCollisionShape(chrono.ChCollisionShapeTriangleMesh(chrono.TriangleMesh().CreateFromWavefrontObj("path/to/mesh.obj")))
mesh_terrain.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3D(20, -5, 0))
system.Add(mesh_terrain)

# Add heightmap-based terrain
heightmap_terrain = chrono.ChBody()
heightmap_terrain.SetCollisionShape(chrono.ChCollisionShapeHeightMap("path/to/heightmap.png", 10, 10))
heightmap_terrain.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3D(30, -5, 0))
system.Add(heightmap_terrain)

# Create interactive driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriver(vehicle)

# Set simulation parameters
system.SetTimestep(0.01)
system.SetMaxIter(100)

# Run simulation
while irr_app.Run():
    system.Increment()
    irr_app.Render()
    chrono.ChTimeStep(step=0.01)

```

    terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(hmmwv.GetSystem())

    terrain_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
    terrain_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
    terrain_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)

    terrain_patch = terrain.AddPatch(terrain_mat, 
                                      chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT), 
                                      veh.GetDataFile("vehicle/terrain/meshes/Highway_col.obj"), 
                                      True,  # Enable collision
                                      0.01)  # Contact material thickness
    terrain_patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))

    # Add visual mesh to terrain
    terrain_mesh = chrono.ChTriangleMeshConnected()
    terrain_mesh.LoadWavefrontMesh(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/meshes/Highway_vis.obj"))
    terrain_shape = chrono.ChVisualShapeTriangleMesh()
    terrain_shape.SetMesh(terrain_mesh)
    terrain_shape.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
    terrain.GetGroundBody().AddVisualShape(terrain_shape)

    terrain.Initialize()

    # Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface
    vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
    vis.SetWindowTitle('HMMWV Rigid Terrain Demo')
    vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
    vis.SetChaseCamera(chrono.ChVector3d(0.0, 0.0, 0.75), 6.0, 0.5)
    vis.Initialize()
    vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
    vis.AddLightDirectional()
    vis.AddSkyBox()
    vis.AttachVehicle(hmmwv.GetVehicle())

    # Create the interactive driver system
    driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)
    driver.SetSteeringDelta(0.02)
    driver.SetThrottleDelta(0.02)
    driver.SetBrakingDelta(0.06)
    driver.Initialize()

    hmmwv.GetVehicle().EnableRealtime(True)

    step_size = 2e-3  # Define step_size

    while vis.Run() :
        time = hmmwv.GetSystem().GetChTime()

        # Draw scene
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()

        # Get driver inputs
        driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

        # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
        driver.Synchronize(time)
        terrain.Synchronize(time)
        hmmwv.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
        vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

        # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
        driver.Advance(step_size)
        terrain.Advance(step_size)
        hmmwv.Advance(step_size)
        vis.Advance(step_size)

    return 0

veh.SetDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + 'vehicle/')

main()
```

2. **Terrain Definition Simplification:** The terrain is now defined with a single patch using a mesh from `vehicle/terrain/meshes/Highway_col.obj`. Collision is enabled with a contact material thickness of `0.01`.

3. **Add Visual Mesh to Terrain:** A visual mesh for the terrain is created from `terrain/meshes/Highway_vis.obj` and added to the terrain's ground body.

5. **Mesh-Related Functions:** Mesh-related functions have been included for creating and adding visual shapes to the terrain.
